record_title: Finite-order flatness obstruction for the intermediate log-subharmonic mean inequality
provenance: A finite-jet expansion for the local ball-versus-sphere mean inequality of positive log-subharmonic functions, prompted by Mochizuki's 2005 intermediate-exponent question and compared with the 2009 Beckenbach–Radó inequality.
limitations: Local positive-point theorem only; zeros, infinite-order-flat smooth germs, and the finite-order endpoint remain unresolved. Originality is to the best of our knowledge and equivalent higher-order Pizzetti formulations may exist. Independent audit has not been performed.
